transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I feel like I’ve shut down and keep reacting badly ever since my work fell apart. I just can’t seem to handle anything that reminds me of getting back into business.
When you encounter things that remind you of what happened, do you experience intrusive memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about that specific event?

No, I don't really have nightmares or flashbacks about what happened. It's more that when a reminder comes up, I get this wave of dread and shame, and I just shut down and want to run away or hide in my garage.
Would you say that your current feelings of sadness and withdrawal are specifically a reaction to the loss of your work, or have you felt this way in other areas of your life unrelated to that event?

It’s definitely tied directly to my work falling apart. Before the business collapsed and my back pain got worse, I was able to juggle my responsibilities and handle life just fine. I really feel like if I could just get the business side sorted out, this whole spiral would ease up.
How long has it been since your business fell apart and these symptoms first started?
My business fell apart about six months ago, and these feelings started within just a few weeks of that happening. So, I've been dealing with this shutdown for about five months now.

Has this emotional reaction caused significant impairment in your daily functioning, such as difficulty maintaining social relationships or completing routine tasks outside of your work-related stressors?

Yes, it's definitely impacted my daily life and my relationships. I've pulled back from my club activities and volunteer work, and I've let all my old customers drift away. It's also put a huge strain on my marriage because money is tight and my wife feels like I'm not pulling my weight at home anymore.
Do you feel that your distress is out of proportion to the severity of the work situation, or is it primarily a direct emotional response to the stress of losing your business?

I feel like it's a direct response to the sheer amount of stress from losing my livelihood and letting my family down. Everything hit me at once with my back pain and the financial pressure, and I just couldn't cope. I really believe that if I could get the business side sorted out, this whole weight would lift.
